lead_independence.headline: Vero Beach High School honors student killed in fall at abandoned Sebastian condo
lead_independence.lead: Vero Beach High School honored 16-year-old Roylynn Scott on Friday night during the school's season opener at Billy Livings Field. Members of the Vero Beach High School band took the field wearing purple ribbons, Roylynn's favorite color, as classmates, teachers, teammates and loved ones filled the stands before kickoff. At her parents' request, the stadium announcer addressed the crowd, sharing details about Roylynn's life, including her love of football games, her passion for art and the impact she had on those around her. As the tribute unfolded, Roylynn's family stood in the bleachers wearing purple in her honor.
